title: Generalized Global Self-Optimizing Control for Chemical Processes: Part II Objective-Guided Controlled Variable Learning Approach
summary: Self-optimizing control (SOC) aims to maintain near-optimal process operation by judiciously selecting controlled variables (CVs). In this series of work, the generalized global SOC (g2SOC) approach is proposed, which extends the concept of SOC to the whole operation space and uses general nonlinear functions to design CVs instead of linear combinations. In the first part of this series work, two numerical approaches for g2SOC are proposed: the optimization-based approach and the regression-based approach, based on a theoretical analysis of the existence of perfect self-optimizing CVs.
